description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across five grouped layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) for different KV cache compression configurations applied to Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct using SnapKV pruning. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” is categorical and divides the model into five contiguous layer groupings. The y-axis, labeled “Relative Change,” is linear and ranges from -25% to +5%, with major gridlines at 5% intervals. A gray dashed horizontal line at 0% represents the baseline (4×tokens, 4-bit), which remains constant across all layers. The yellow line with circle markers (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) starts near 0%, dips slightly to approximately -2% at Layer5-12, reaches -5% at Layer13-20, then recovers to 0% by Layer29-32. The red line with square markers (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) begins near 0%, declines to -5% at Layer5-12, drops further to -10% at Layer13-20, and returns to 0% by Layer29-32. The light blue line with circle markers (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) starts at -2%, falls to -5% at Layer5-12, plunges to -15% at Layer13-20, then rises to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line with square markers (RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit) begins at -4%, drops to -5% at Layer5-12, plummets to -25% at Layer13-20, and partially recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. All lines show a pronounced dip in relative performance at Layer13-20, with RULER4k configurations exhibiting steeper declines than LB-Avg, indicating greater sensitivity to layer-wise quantization in intermediate layers.
caption_used: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as the pruning method, are shown. The plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groupings, with the x-axis labeled 'Layer' and the y-axis labeled 'Relative Change'. The gray dashed line represents the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit, which remains constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) shows a steady trend, with a slight dip to approximately -5% at Layer13-20 before returning to 0%. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) follows a similar pattern, dipping to -10% at Layer13-20 and recovering to 0% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) starts at -2%, dips to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises back to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. Overall, the LB-Avg methods demonstrate more stability compared to the RULER4k methods, which exhibit sharper declines at intermediate layers.
